technical.summary: QRVO shows isolated bullish structure signals (supertrend, hull) but lacks momentum confirmation; oversold conditions without rising oscillators and price below all key moving averages create a weak, high-risk entry setup.

fundamental.summary: QRVO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 22 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear market sentiment (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is minimal and mixed (junior member small sales), with no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro deterioration with inverted yield curve, crisis VIX (348), rising dollar, imminent CPI event, and credit stress create hostile environment for tech equities; earnings in 22 days adds binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (19/100) and contrarian buy signal combined with isolated supertrend/hull bullish structure offer asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes, with support at 80.19 providing defined downside.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, rising dollar), complete absence of momentum confirmation (RSI/Stoch/MACD all bearish), price below all major moving averages, and earnings binary risk in 22 days create a hostile environment that overwhelms isolated technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment (19/100) presents contrarian opportunity, and isolated supertrend/hull bullish structure offers technical support; however, severe macro deterioration, complete momentum void, and imminent earnings binary risk create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis (348), and earnings event in 22 days create hostile macro environment where isolated technical signals lack confirmation and offer no protection against downside acceleration.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite contrarian sentiment signal
decision.portfolio_note: Already 3 positions in Information Technology sector; adding QRVO increases concentration risk in high-volatility tech during macro crisis without conviction support.
